description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取基金经理汇总信息。可按基金经理代码批量查询，返回基金经理代码、管理年限、管理基金数量、在管基金数量、管理资产规模等数据。当用户想了解某公募基金经理或者对比某些公募基金经理的管理规模和资历，判断其管理经验和能力时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain summarized fund manager information. Supports batch query by fund manager codes, returning fields such as fund manager code, years of management, number of funds managed, number of funds currently managed, and managed asset scale. Call this interface when users want to understand the management scale and experience of a fund manager or assess their management capability.
